records.title: Custom properties (--*): CSS variables - CSS | MDN
records.description: Property names that are prefixed with --, like --example-name, represent custom properties that contain a value that can be used in other declarations using the var() function.

records.name: -webkit-text-fill-color
records.title: -webkit-text-fill-color CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The -webkit-text-fill-color CSS property specifies the fill color of characters of text. If this property is not set, the value of the color property is used.

records.name: -webkit-text-stroke
records.title: -webkit-text-stroke CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The -webkit-text-stroke CSS shorthand property specifies the width and color of strokes for text characters.

records.name: -webkit-text-stroke-color
records.title: -webkit-text-stroke-color CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The -webkit-text-stroke-color CSS property specifies the stroke color of characters of text. If this property is not set, the value of the color property is used.

records.name: -webkit-text-stroke-width
records.title: -webkit-text-stroke-width CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The -webkit-text-stroke-width CSS property specifies the width of the stroke for text.

records.name: accent-color
records.title: accent-color CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The accent-color CSS property sets the accent color for user-interface controls generated by some elements.

records.name: appearance
records.title: appearance CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The appearance CSS property specifies the rendered appearance of replaced UI widget elements such as form controls. Most commonly, such elements are given native, platform-specific styling based on the operating system's theme, or a primitive appearance with styles that can be overridden using CSS.

records.name: caret
records.title: caret CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The caret CSS shorthand property sets the appearance and behavior of the insertion caret in a single declaration.

records.name: caret-animation
records.title: caret-animation CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The caret-animation CSS property is used to enable or disable the blinking behavior of the insertion caret, the visible marker that appears in editable elements to indicate where the next character will be inserted or deleted.

records.name: caret-color
records.title: caret-color CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The caret-color CSS property sets the color of the insertion caret, sometimes referred to as the text input cursor. This is the visible marker appearing at the insertion point where the next character typed will be added or where the next character deleted will be removed.

records.name: caret-shape
records.title: caret-shape CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The caret-shape CSS property sets the shape of the insertion caret, the visible marker that appears in editable elements to indicate where the next character will be inserted or deleted.

records.name: cursor
records.title: cursor CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The cursor CSS property sets the mouse cursor, if any, to show when the mouse pointer is over an element.

records.name: interactivity
records.title: interactivity CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The interactivity CSS property specifies whether an element and its descendant nodes are set to be inert.

records.name: interest-delay
records.title: interest-delay CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The interest-delay CSS property specifies the delay between the user showing interest in an interest invoker element and the interest event firing, and the delay between the user losing interest and the loseinterest event firing.

records.name: interest-delay-end
records.title: interest-delay-end CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The interest-delay-end CSS property specifies the delay between the user losing interest in an interest invoker element and the loseinterest event firing.

records.name: interest-delay-start
records.title: interest-delay-start CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The interest-delay-start CSS property specifies the delay between the user showing interest in an interest invoker element and the interest event firing.

records.name: outline
records.title: outline CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The outline CSS shorthand property sets the style, color, and width of an element's outline.

records.name: outline-color
records.title: outline-color CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The outline-color CSS property sets the color of an element's outline.

records.name: outline-offset
records.title: outline-offset CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The outline-offset CSS property sets the amount of space between an outline and the edge or border of an element.

records.name: outline-style
records.title: outline-style CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The outline-style CSS property sets the style of an element's outline. An outline is a line that is drawn around an element, outside the border.

records.name: outline-width
records.title: outline-width CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The CSS outline-width property sets the thickness of an element's outline. An outline is a line that is drawn around an element, outside the border.

records.name: pointer-events
records.title: pointer-events CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The pointer-events CSS property sets under what circumstances (if any) a particular graphic element can become the target of pointer events.

records.name: resize
records.title: resize CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The resize CSS property sets whether an element is resizable, and if so, in which directions.

records.name: user-select
records.title: user-select CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The user-select CSS property controls whether the user can select text. This doesn't have any effect on content loaded as part of a browser's user interface (its chrome), except in textboxes.

records.name: window-drag
records.title: Page not found | MDN
records.description: Specifies whether an element can act as an installed application window drag area; the Working Draft defines none and move, and the browser can suppress ordinary pointer events during a window move.

records.name: alignment-baseline
records.title: alignment-baseline CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The alignment-baseline CSS property specifies the specific baseline used to align the box's text and inline-level contents. Baseline alignment is the relationship among the baselines of multiple alignment subjects within an alignment context. When performing baseline alignment, the alignment-baseline property value specifies which baseline of the box is aligned to the corresponding baseline of its alignment context.

records.name: baseline-shift
records.title: baseline-shift CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The baseline-shift CSS property repositions the dominant-baseline of a text element relative to the dominant-baseline of its parent text content element. The shifted element might be a sub- or superscript. If the property is present, the value overrides the element's baseline-shift attribute.

records.name: baseline-source
records.title: baseline-source CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description:
The baseline-source CSS property defines which baseline to use when inline-level boxes have multiple possible baselines, such as multi-line inline blocks or inline flex containers.
The values allow for choosing between aligning to the box's first baseline, last baseline, or letting the browser decide automatically based on the box type.

records.name: dominant-baseline
records.title: dominant-baseline CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The dominant-baseline CSS property specifies the specific baseline used to align the box's text and inline-level contents. It also indicates the default alignment baseline of any boxes participating in baseline alignment in the box's alignment context. If present, it overrides the shape's dominant-baseline attribute.

records.name: initial-letter
records.title: initial-letter CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The initial-letter CSS property sets the size and sink for dropped, raised, and sunken initial letters. This property applies to ::first-letter pseudo-elements and inline-level first children of block containers.

records.name: line-height
records.title: line-height CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The line-height CSS property sets the height of a line box in horizontal writing modes. In vertical writing modes, it sets the width of a line box. It's commonly used to set the distance between lines of text. On block-level elements in horizontal writing modes, it specifies the preferred height of line boxes within the element, and on non-replaced inline elements, it specifies the height that is used to calculate line box height.

records.name: text-box
records.title: text-box CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The text-box CSS shorthand property corresponds to the text-box-trim and text-box-edge properties, which together specify the amount of space to trim from the block-start edge and block-end edge of a text element's block container.

records.name: text-box-edge
records.title: text-box-edge CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The text-box-edge CSS property specifies an amount of space to trim from a text element's block container.

records.name: text-box-trim
records.title: text-box-trim CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The text-box-trim CSS property specifies which of the over and under edges of text content to trim from a text element's block container.

records.name: vertical-align
records.title: vertical-align CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The vertical-align CSS shorthand property sets the vertical alignment of an inline, inline-block, or table-cell box.

records.name: all
records.title: all CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The all CSS shorthand property resets all of an element's properties except unicode-bidi, direction, and CSS Custom Properties. It can set properties to their initial or inherited values, or to the values specified in another cascade layer or stylesheet origin.

records.name: animation
records.title: animation CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The animation CSS shorthand property applies an animation between styles. It is a shorthand for animation-name, animation-duration, animation-timing-function, animation-delay, animation-iteration-count, animation-direction, animation-fill-mode, animation-play-state, and animation-timeline.

records.name: animation-composition
records.title: animation-composition CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The animation-composition CSS property specifies the composite operation to use when multiple animations affect the same property simultaneously.

records.name: animation-delay
records.title: animation-delay CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The animation-delay CSS property specifies the amount of time to wait from applying the animation to an element before beginning to perform the animation. The animation can start later, immediately from its beginning, or immediately and partway through the animation.

records.name: animation-direction
records.title: animation-direction CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The animation-direction CSS property sets whether an animation should play forward, backward, or alternate back and forth between playing the sequence forward and backward.

records.name: animation-duration
records.title: animation-duration CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The animation-duration CSS property sets the length of time that an animation takes to complete one cycle.

records.name: animation-fill-mode
records.title: animation-fill-mode CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The animation-fill-mode CSS property sets how a CSS animation applies styles to its target before and after its execution.

records.name: animation-iteration-count
records.title: animation-iteration-count CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The animation-iteration-count CSS property sets the number of times an animation sequence should be played before stopping.

records.name: animation-name
records.title: animation-name CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The animation-name CSS property specifies the names of one or more @keyframes at-rules that describe the animation to apply to an element. Multiple @keyframes at-rules are specified as a comma-separated list of names. If the specified name does not match any @keyframes at-rule, no properties are animated.

records.name: animation-play-state
records.title: animation-play-state CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The animation-play-state CSS property sets whether an animation is running or paused.

records.name: animation-timing-function
records.title: animation-timing-function CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The animation-timing-function CSS property sets how an animation progresses through the duration of each cycle.

records.name: animation-trigger
records.title: animation-trigger CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The animation-trigger CSS property specifies whether CSS animations declared on an element are triggered animations (or not) and, if so, what their triggers are and how they should behave when the trigger becomes active or inactive. This is used to create scroll-triggered animations.

records.name: timeline-trigger
records.title: timeline-trigger CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The timeline-trigger CSS shorthand property defines a scroll-triggered animation trigger on an element.

records.name: timeline-trigger-activation-range
records.title: timeline-trigger-activation-range CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The timeline-trigger-activation-range CSS shorthand property specifies the start and end of a scroll-triggered animation trigger's activation range.

records.name: timeline-trigger-activation-range-end
records.title: timeline-trigger-activation-range-end CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The timeline-trigger-activation-range-end CSS property specifies the end of a scroll-triggered animation trigger's activation range.

records.name: timeline-trigger-activation-range-start
records.title: timeline-trigger-activation-range-start CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The timeline-trigger-activation-range-start CSS property specifies the start of a scroll-triggered animation trigger's activation range.

records.name: timeline-trigger-active-range
records.title: timeline-trigger-active-range CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The timeline-trigger-active-range CSS shorthand property specifies a scroll-triggered animation trigger's active range.

records.name: timeline-trigger-active-range-end
records.title: timeline-trigger-active-range-end CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The timeline-trigger-active-range-end CSS property specifies the end of a scroll-triggered animation trigger's active range.

records.name: timeline-trigger-active-range-start
records.title: timeline-trigger-active-range-start CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The timeline-trigger-active-range-start CSS property specifies the start of a scroll-triggered animation trigger's active range.

records.name: timeline-trigger-name
records.title: timeline-trigger-name CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The timeline-trigger-name CSS property specifies a scroll-triggered animation trigger's identifier(s).

records.name: timeline-trigger-source
records.title: timeline-trigger-source CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The timeline-trigger-source CSS property specifies the timeline that will trigger a scroll-triggered animation.

records.name: trigger-scope
records.title: trigger-scope CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The trigger-scope CSS property can be used to limit the scope of a scroll-triggered animation trigger name to a document subtree.

records.name: backdrop-filter
records.title: backdrop-filter CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The backdrop-filter CSS property lets you apply graphical effects such as blurring or color shifting to the area behind an element. Because it applies to everything behind the element, to see the effect the element or its background needs to be transparent or partially transparent.

records.name: color-interpolation-filters
records.title: color-interpolation-filters CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The color-interpolation-filters CSS property specifies the color space for imaging operations performed via SVG filter effects. If explicitly declared, the value of the CSS property overrides any value given in the element's color-interpolation-filters attribute.

records.name: filter
records.title: filter CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The filter CSS property applies graphical effects like blur or color shift to an element. Filters are commonly used to adjust the rendering of images, backgrounds, and borders.

records.name: flood-color
records.title: flood-color CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The flood-color CSS property defines the color of the current filter primitive subregion in <feFlood> and <feDropShadow> elements within a <filter>. If present, it overrides the element's flood-color attribute.

records.name: flood-opacity
records.title: flood-opacity CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The flood-opacity CSS property defines the opacity of the current filter primitive subregion in <feFlood> and <feDropShadow> elements within a <filter>. If present, it overrides the element's flood-opacity attribute.

records.name: lighting-color
records.title: lighting-color CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The lighting-color CSS property defines the color of the light source for the <feDiffuseLighting> and <feSpecularLighting> SVG lighting filter primitives within an SVG <filter>. If present, it overrides the element's lighting-color attribute.

records.name: backface-visibility
records.title: backface-visibility CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The backface-visibility CSS property sets whether the back face of an element is visible when turned towards the user.

records.name: perspective
records.title: perspective CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The perspective CSS property determines the distance between the z=0 plane and the user in order to give a 3D-positioned element some perspective.

records.name: perspective-origin
records.title: perspective-origin CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The perspective-origin CSS property determines the position at which the viewer is looking. It is used as the vanishing point by the perspective property.

records.name: rotate
records.title: rotate CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The rotate CSS property allows you to specify rotation transforms individually and independently of the transform property. This maps better to typical user interface usage, and saves having to remember the exact order of transform functions to specify in the transform property.

records.name: scale
records.title: scale CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The scale CSS property allows you to specify scale transforms individually and independently of the transform property. This maps better to typical user interface usage, and saves having to remember the exact order of transform functions to specify in the transform value.

records.name: transform
records.title: transform CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description:
The transform CSS property lets you rotate, scale, skew, or translate an element.
It modifies the coordinate space of the CSS visual formatting model.

records.name: transform-box
records.title: transform-box CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The transform-box CSS property defines the layout box to which the transform, individual transform properties translate, scale, and rotate, and transform-origin properties relate.

records.name: transform-origin
records.title: transform-origin CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The transform-origin CSS property sets the origin for an element's transformations.

records.name: transform-style
records.title: transform-style CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The transform-style CSS property sets whether children of an element are positioned in the 3D space or are flattened in the plane of the element.

records.name: translate
records.title: translate CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The translate CSS property allows you to specify translation transforms individually and independently of the transform property. This maps better to typical user interface usage, and saves having to remember the exact order of transform functions to specify in the transform value.

records.name: background
records.title: background CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The background CSS shorthand property sets all background style properties at once, such as color, image, origin, size, and repeat method.

records.name: background-attachment
records.title: background-attachment CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The background-attachment CSS property sets whether a background image's position is fixed within the viewport, or scrolls with its containing block.

records.name: background-clip
records.title: background-clip CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The background-clip CSS property sets whether an element's background extends underneath its border box, padding box, or content box.

records.name: background-color
records.title: background-color CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The background-color CSS property sets the background color of an element.

records.name: background-image
records.title: background-image CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The background-image CSS property sets one or more background images on an element.

records.name: background-origin
records.title: background-origin CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The background-origin CSS property sets the background's origin: from the border start, inside the border, or inside the padding.

records.name: background-position
records.title: background-position CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The background-position CSS property sets the initial position for each background image.

records.name: background-position-x
records.title: background-position-x CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The background-position-x CSS property sets the initial horizontal position for each background image. The position is relative to the position layer set by background-origin.

records.name: background-position-y
records.title: background-position-y CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The background-position-y CSS property sets the initial vertical position for each background image. The position is relative to the position layer set by background-origin.

records.name: background-repeat
records.title: background-repeat CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The background-repeat CSS shorthand property sets how background images are repeated. A background image can be repeated along the horizontal and vertical axes, or not repeated at all.

records.name: background-size
records.title: background-size CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description:
The background-size CSS property sets the size of the element's background image.
The image can be left to its natural size, stretched, or constrained to fit the available space.

records.name: border
records.title: border CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The border CSS shorthand property sets an element's border. It sets the values of border-width, border-style, and border-color.

records.name: border-bottom
records.title: border-bottom CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The border-bottom CSS shorthand property sets an element's bottom border. It sets the values of border-bottom-width, border-bottom-style and border-bottom-color.

records.name: border-bottom-color
records.title: border-bottom-color CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The border-bottom-color CSS property sets the color of an element's bottom border. It can also be set with the shorthand CSS properties border-color or border-bottom.

records.name: border-bottom-left-radius
records.title: border-bottom-left-radius CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The border-bottom-left-radius CSS property rounds the bottom-left corner of an element by specifying the radius (or the radius of the semi-major and semi-minor axes) of the ellipse defining the curvature of the corner.

records.name: border-bottom-right-radius
records.title: border-bottom-right-radius CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The border-bottom-right-radius CSS property rounds the bottom-right corner of an element by specifying the radius (or the radius of the semi-major and semi-minor axes) of the ellipse defining the curvature of the corner.

records.name: border-bottom-style
records.title: border-bottom-style CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The border-bottom-style CSS property sets the line style of an element's bottom border.

records.name: border-bottom-width
records.title: border-bottom-width CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The border-bottom-width CSS property sets the width of the bottom border of an element.

records.name: border-color
records.title: border-color CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The border-color CSS shorthand property sets the color of an element's border.

records.name: border-image
records.title: border-image CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The border-image CSS shorthand property draws an image around a given element. It replaces the element's regular border.

records.name: border-image-outset
records.title: border-image-outset CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The border-image-outset CSS property sets the distance by which an element's border image is set out from its border box.

records.name: border-image-repeat
records.title: border-image-repeat CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The border-image-repeat CSS property defines how the images for the sides and the middle part of the border image are scaled and tiled. The middle region can be displayed by using the keyword "fill" in the border-image-slice property.

records.name: border-image-slice
records.title: border-image-slice CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The border-image-slice CSS property divides the image specified by border-image-source into regions. These regions form the components of an element's border image.

records.name: border-image-source
records.title: border-image-source CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The border-image-source CSS property sets the source image used to create an element's border image.

records.name: border-image-width
records.title: border-image-width CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The border-image-width CSS property sets the width of an element's border image.

records.name: border-left
records.title: border-left CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The border-left CSS shorthand property sets all the properties of an element's left border.

records.name: border-left-color
records.title: border-left-color CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The border-left-color CSS property sets the color of an element's left border. It can also be set with the shorthand CSS properties border-color or border-left.

records.name: border-left-style
records.title: border-left-style CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The border-left-style CSS property sets the line style of an element's left border.

records.name: border-left-width
records.title: border-left-width CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The border-left-width CSS property sets the width of the left border of an element.

records.name: border-radius
records.title: border-radius CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The border-radius CSS shorthand property rounds the corners of an element's outer border edge. You can set a single radius to make circular corners, or two radii to make elliptical corners.

records.name: border-right
records.title: border-right CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The border-right CSS shorthand property sets all the properties of an element's right border.

records.name: border-right-color
records.title: border-right-color CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The border-right-color CSS property sets the color of an element's right border. It can also be set with the shorthand CSS properties border-color or border-right.

records.name: border-right-style
records.title: border-right-style CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The border-right-style CSS property sets the line style of an element's right border.

records.name: border-right-width
records.title: border-right-width CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The border-right-width CSS property sets the width of the right border of an element.

records.name: border-shape
records.title: border-shape CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The border-shape CSS property defines an element's border shape using <basic-shape> values.

records.name: border-style
records.title: border-style CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The border-style CSS shorthand property sets the line style for all four sides of an element's border.

records.name: border-top
records.title: border-top CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The border-top CSS shorthand property sets all the properties of an element's top border.

records.name: border-top-color
records.title: border-top-color CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The border-top-color CSS property sets the color of an element's top border. It can also be set with the shorthand CSS properties border-color or border-top.

records.name: border-top-left-radius
records.title: border-top-left-radius CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The border-top-left-radius CSS property rounds the top-left corner of an element by specifying the radius (or the radius of the semi-major and semi-minor axes) of the ellipse defining the curvature of the corner.

records.name: border-top-right-radius
records.title: border-top-right-radius CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The border-top-right-radius CSS property rounds the top-right corner of an element by specifying the radius (or the radius of the semi-major and semi-minor axes) of the ellipse defining the curvature of the corner.

records.name: border-top-style
records.title: border-top-style CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The border-top-style CSS property sets the line style of an element's top border.

records.name: border-top-width
records.title: border-top-width CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The border-top-width CSS property sets the width of the top border of an element.

records.name: border-width
records.title: border-width CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The border-width CSS shorthand property sets the width of an element's border.

records.name: box-shadow
records.title: box-shadow CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The box-shadow CSS property adds shadow effects around an element's frame. You can set multiple effects separated by commas. A box shadow is described by X and Y offsets relative to the element, blur and spread radius, and color.

records.name: corner-block-end-shape
records.title: corner-block-end-shape CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The corner-block-end-shape CSS property specifies the shape of both the corners on a box's block-end edge, within their border-radius area.

records.name: corner-block-start-shape
records.title: corner-block-start-shape CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The corner-block-start-shape CSS property specifies the shape of both the corners on a box's block-start edge, within their border-radius area.

records.name: corner-bottom-left-shape
records.title: corner-bottom-left-shape CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The corner-bottom-left-shape CSS property specifies the shape of a box's bottom-left corner, within its border-radius area.

records.name: corner-bottom-right-shape
records.title: corner-bottom-right-shape CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The corner-bottom-right-shape CSS property specifies the shape of a box's bottom-right corner, within its border-radius area.

records.name: corner-bottom-shape
records.title: corner-bottom-shape CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The corner-bottom-shape CSS property specifies the shape of both the corners on a box's bottom edge, within their border-radius area.

records.name: corner-end-end-shape
records.title: corner-end-end-shape CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The corner-end-end-shape CSS property specifies the shape of a box's block-end and inline-end corner, within its border-radius area.

records.name: corner-end-start-shape
records.title: corner-end-start-shape CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The corner-end-start-shape CSS property specifies the shape of a box's block-end and inline-start corner, within its border-radius area.

records.name: corner-inline-end-shape
records.title: corner-inline-end-shape CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The corner-inline-end-shape CSS property specifies the shape of both the corners on a box's inline-end edge, within their border-radius area.

records.name: corner-inline-start-shape
records.title: corner-inline-start-shape CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The corner-inline-start-shape CSS property specifies the shape of both the corners on a box's inline-start edge, within their border-radius area.

records.name: corner-left-shape
records.title: corner-left-shape CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The corner-left-shape CSS property specifies the shape of both the corners on a box's left-hand edge, within their border-radius area.

records.name: corner-right-shape
records.title: corner-right-shape CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The corner-right-shape CSS property specifies the shape of both the corners on a box's right-hand edge, within their border-radius area.

records.name: corner-shape
records.title: corner-shape CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The corner-shape CSS shorthand property specifies the shape of a box's corners, within the area specified by its border-radius property value.

records.name: corner-start-end-shape
records.title: corner-start-end-shape CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The corner-start-end-shape CSS property specifies the shape of a box's block-start and inline-end corner, within its border-radius area.

records.name: corner-start-start-shape
records.title: corner-start-start-shape CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The corner-start-start-shape CSS property specifies the shape of a box's block-start and inline-start corner, within its border-radius area.

records.name: corner-top-left-shape
records.title: corner-top-left-shape CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The corner-top-left-shape CSS property specifies the shape of a box's top-left corner, within its border-radius area.

records.name: corner-top-right-shape
records.title: corner-top-right-shape CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The corner-top-right-shape CSS property specifies the shape of a box's top-right corner, within its border-radius area.

records.name: corner-top-shape
records.title: corner-top-shape CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The corner-top-shape CSS property specifies the shape of both the corners on a box's top edge, within their border-radius area.

records.name: background-blend-mode
records.title: background-blend-mode CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The background-blend-mode CSS property sets how an element's background images should blend with each other and with the element's background color.

records.name: isolation
records.title: isolation CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The isolation CSS property determines whether an element must create a new stacking context.

records.name: mix-blend-mode
records.title: mix-blend-mode CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The mix-blend-mode CSS property sets how an element's content should blend with its backdrop — the content rendered behind the element within the same stacking context.

records.name: clip-path
records.title: clip-path CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The clip-path CSS property creates a clipping region that sets what part of an element should be shown. Parts that are inside the region are shown, while those outside are hidden.

records.name: clip-rule
records.title: clip-rule CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The clip-rule CSS property determines, when parts of the path overlap other parts, which pixels in a mask's box are inside the clipping shape defined by a clip path and which are outside.

records.name: mask
records.title: mask CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The mask CSS shorthand property hides an element (partially or fully) by masking or clipping a specified area of the image. It is a shorthand for all the mask-* properties. The property accepts one or more comma-separated values, where each value corresponds to a <mask-layer>.

records.name: mask-border
records.title: mask-border CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The mask-border CSS shorthand property lets you create a mask along the edge of an element's border.

records.name: mask-border-mode
records.title: mask-border-mode CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The mask-border-mode CSS property specifies the blending mode used in a mask border.

records.name: mask-border-outset
records.title: mask-border-outset CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The mask-border-outset CSS property specifies the distance by which an element's mask border is set out from its border box.

records.name: mask-border-repeat
records.title: mask-border-repeat CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The mask-border-repeat CSS property specifies how the images for the sides and the middle part of the mask border image are scaled and tiled.

records.name: mask-border-slice
records.title: mask-border-slice CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The mask-border-slice CSS property divides the image set by mask-border-source into regions. These regions are used to form the components of an element's mask border.

records.name: mask-border-source
records.title: mask-border-source CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The mask-border-source CSS property sets the source image used to create an element's mask border.

records.name: mask-border-width
records.title: mask-border-width CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The mask-border-width CSS property sets the width of an element's mask border.

records.name: mask-clip
records.title: mask-clip CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The mask-clip CSS property determines the area which is affected by a mask. The painted content of an element must be restricted to this area.

records.name: mask-composite
records.title: mask-composite CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The mask-composite CSS property represents a compositing operation used on the current mask layer with the mask layers below it.

records.name: mask-image
records.title: mask-image CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The mask-image CSS property sets the image that is used as the mask layer for an element, hiding sections of the element on which the masking image is set based on the alpha channel of the mask image and, depending on the mask-mode property value, the luminance of the mask image's colors.

records.name: mask-mode
records.title: mask-mode CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The mask-mode CSS property is set on the element being masked. It sets whether the mask reference defined by the mask-image is treated as a luminance or alpha mask.

records.name: mask-origin
records.title: mask-origin CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description:
The mask-origin CSS property sets the origin of a mask. This property determines the mask positioning area: the area within which a mask image is positioned. HTML elements can have masks contained within their content border box, padding box, or content box, whereas SVG elements (which don't have the associated CSS layout boxes) can have masks contained inside their fill, stroke, or view box.
For elements rendered as multiple boxes, such as a <span> of text that spans more than one line, the mask-origin property specifies which boxes the box-decoration-break property operates on to determine the mask positioning area.

records.name: mask-position
records.title: mask-position CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The mask-position CSS property sets the initial position, relative to the mask position layer set by mask-origin, for each defined mask image.

records.name: mask-repeat
records.title: mask-repeat CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The mask-repeat CSS property sets how mask images are repeated. A mask image can be repeated along the horizontal axis, the vertical axis, both axes, or not repeated at all.

records.name: mask-size
records.title: mask-size CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The mask-size CSS property specifies the sizes of specified mask images. Mask image sizes can be fully or partially constrained to preserve their intrinsic aspect ratios.

records.name: mask-type
records.title: mask-type CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The mask-type CSS property applies to the SVG <mask> element. It defines whether to use the luminance (brightness) or alpha (transparency) content of the mask. This property may be overridden by the mask-mode property. The mask-type property has no effect on image or gradient masks.

records.name: color
records.title: color CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The color CSS property sets the foreground color value of an element's text and text decorations, and sets the currentColor value. currentColor may be used as an indirect value on other properties and is the default for other color properties, such as border-color.

records.name: color-scheme
records.title: color-scheme CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The color-scheme CSS property allows an element to indicate which color schemes it can comfortably be rendered in. User agents change the following aspects of the UI chrome to match the used color scheme:

records.name: dynamic-range-limit
records.title: dynamic-range-limit CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The dynamic-range-limit CSS property specifies the maximum luminance allowed for High Dynamic Range (HDR) content.

records.name: forced-color-adjust
records.title: forced-color-adjust CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The forced-color-adjust CSS property allows authors to opt certain elements out of forced colors mode. This then restores the control of those values to CSS.

records.name: opacity
records.title: opacity CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The opacity CSS property sets the opacity of an element. Opacity is the degree to which content behind an element is hidden, and is the opposite of transparency.

records.name: print-color-adjust
records.title: print-color-adjust CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description:
The print-color-adjust CSS property sets what, if anything, the user agent may do to optimize the appearance of the element on the output device.
By default, the browser is allowed to make any adjustments to the element's appearance it determines to be necessary and prudent given the type and capabilities of the output device.

records.name: content
records.title: content CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The content CSS property replaces content with a generated value. It can be used to define what is rendered inside an element or pseudo-element. For elements, the content property specifies whether the element renders normally (normal or none) or is replaced with an image (and associated "alt" text). For pseudo-elements and margin boxes, content defines the content as images, text, both, or none, which determines whether the element renders at all.

records.name: quotes
records.title: quotes CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The CSS quotes property sets how the browser should render quotation marks that are automatically added to the HTML <q> element or added using the open-quotes or close-quotes (or omitted using the no-open-quote and no-close-quote) values of the of the CSS content property.

records.name: counter-increment
records.title: counter-increment CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The counter-increment CSS property can be used to increase or decrease the value of the named CSS counters by the specified values, or to prevent all counters or an individual counter's value from being changed.

records.name: counter-reset
records.title: counter-reset CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The counter-reset CSS property creates named CSS counters and initializes their values. It can create both regular and reversed counters.

records.name: counter-set
records.title: counter-set CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The counter-set CSS property sets CSS counters on the element to the given values.

records.name: list-style
records.title: list-style CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The list-style CSS shorthand property allows you to set all the list style properties at once.

records.name: list-style-image
records.title: list-style-image CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The list-style-image CSS property sets an image to be used as the list item marker.

records.name: list-style-position
records.title: list-style-position CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The list-style-position CSS property sets the position of the ::marker relative to a list item.

records.name: list-style-type
records.title: list-style-type CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The list-style-type CSS property sets the marker (such as a disc, character, or custom counter style) of a list item element.

records.name: cx
records.title: cx CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The cx CSS property defines the x-axis center point of an SVG <circle> or <ellipse> element. If present, it overrides the element's cx attribute.

records.name: cy
records.title: cy CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The cy CSS property defines the y-axis center point of an SVG <circle> or <ellipse> elements. If present, it overrides the element's cy attribute.

records.name: d
records.title: d CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The d CSS property defines a path to be drawn by the SVG <path> element. If present, it overrides the element's d attribute.

records.name: fill
records.title: fill CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The fill CSS property defines how SVG text content and the interior canvas of SVG shapes are filled or painted. If present, it overrides the element's fill attribute.

records.name: fill-opacity
records.title: fill-opacity CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The fill-opacity CSS property defines the opacity of the painting operation (color, gradient, pattern, etc.) applied to SVG shapes or text content elements to fill the element. The property defines the opacity of the element's fill only; it does not affect the stroke. If present, it overrides the element's fill-opacity attribute.

records.name: fill-rule
records.title: fill-rule CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The fill-rule CSS property defines the rule used to determine which parts of the SVG shape's canvas are included inside a shape to be filled. If present, it overrides the element's fill-rule attribute.

records.name: marker
records.title: marker CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The marker CSS property points to a marker that will be drawn on the first, middle, and last vertices of the element's path; that is, at all of its vertices. The marker must have been defined using an SVG <marker> element, and can only be referenced with a <url> value. The value of the CSS property overrides any values of the marker-start, marker, and marker-end attributes in the SVG.

records.name: marker-end
records.title: marker-end CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The marker-end CSS property points to a marker that will be drawn on the last vertex of the element's path; that is, at its ending vertex. The marker must have been defined using an SVG <marker> element, and can only be referenced with a <url> value. The value of the CSS property overrides any values of the marker-end attribute in the SVG.

records.name: marker-mid
records.title: marker-mid CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The marker-mid CSS property points to a marker that will be drawn on the middle vertices of the element's path; that is, at each of its vertices between the start and end vertices. The marker must have been defined using an SVG <marker> element, and can only be referenced with a <url> value. The value of the CSS property overrides any values of the marker-mid attribute in the SVG.

records.name: marker-start
records.title: marker-start CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The marker-start CSS property points to a marker that will be drawn on the first vertex of the element's path; that is, at its starting vertex. The marker must have been defined using an SVG <marker> element, and can only be referenced with a <url> value. The value of the CSS property overrides any values of the marker-start attribute in the SVG.

records.name: paint-order
records.title: paint-order CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The paint-order CSS property lets you control the order in which the fill and stroke (and painting markers) of text content and shapes are drawn.

records.name: path-length
records.title: path-length CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The path-length CSS property specifies a total path length, in user units. All path computations are then scaled using the ratio path-length / (computed value of path length) — this includes text paths, animation paths, and various stroke operations.

records.name: r
records.title: r CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The r CSS property defines the radius of a circle. It can only be used with the SVG <circle> element. If present, it overrides the circle's r attribute.

records.name: rx
records.title: rx CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The rx CSS property defines the x-axis, or horizontal, radius of an SVG <ellipse> and the horizontal curve of the corners of an SVG <rect> rectangle. If present, it overrides the shape's rx attribute.

records.name: ry
records.title: ry CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The ry CSS property defines the y-axis, or vertical, radius of an SVG <ellipse> and the vertical curve of the corners of an SVG <rect> rectangle. If present, it overrides the shape's ry attribute.

records.name: shape-rendering
records.title: shape-rendering CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description:
The shape-rendering CSS property provides hints to the renderer about what tradeoffs to make when rendering shapes like paths, circles, or rectangles.
It only has an effect on the <circle>, <ellipse>, <line>, <path>, <polygon>, <polyline>, and <rect> elements. If explicitly declared, the value of the CSS property overrides the any values of the element's shape-rendering attribute.

records.name: stop-color
records.title: stop-color CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The stop-color CSS property defines the color to use for an SVG <stop> element within a gradient. If present, it overrides the element's stop-color attribute.

records.name: stop-opacity
records.title: stop-opacity CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The stop-opacity CSS property defines the opacity of a given color gradient stop in the SVG <stop> element within an SVG gradient. If present, it overrides the element's stop-opacity attribute.

records.name: stroke
records.title: stroke CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The stroke CSS property defines the color or SVG paint server used to draw an element's stroke. As such, stroke only has an effect on elements that can be given a stroke (for example, <rect> or <ellipse>); see the page on the SVG stroke attribute for a complete list. When declared, the CSS value overrides any value of the element's stroke SVG attribute.

records.name: stroke-dasharray
records.title: stroke-dasharray CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The stroke-dasharray CSS property defines a pattern of dashes and gaps used in the painting of the SVG shape's stroke. If present, it overrides the element's stroke-dasharray attribute.

records.name: stroke-dashoffset
records.title: stroke-dashoffset CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The stroke-dashoffset CSS property defines an offset for the starting point of the rendering of an SVG element's associated dash array. If present, it overrides the element's stroke-dashoffset attribute.

records.name: stroke-linecap
records.title: stroke-linecap CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The stroke-linecap CSS property defines the shape to be used at the end of open subpaths of SVG elements' unclosed strokes. If present, it overrides the element's stroke-linecap attribute.

records.name: stroke-linejoin
records.title: stroke-linejoin CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The stroke-linejoin CSS property defines the shape to be used at the corners of an SVG element's stroked paths. If present, it overrides the element's stroke-linejoin attribute.

records.name: stroke-miterlimit
records.title: stroke-miterlimit CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The stroke-miterlimit CSS property defines a limit on the ratio of the miter length to the stroke-width when the shape to be used at the corners of an SVG element's stroked path is a mitered join. If the limit defined by this property is exceeded, the join is converted from miter to bevel, thus making the corner appear truncated.

records.name: stroke-opacity
records.title: stroke-opacity CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The stroke-opacity CSS property defines the opacity of an SVG shape's stroke. The effect is identical to that of opacity, except it is applied only to the stroke, not to the entire element. If present, it overrides the element's stroke-opacity attribute.

records.name: stroke-width
records.title: stroke-width CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The stroke-width CSS property defines the width of a stroke applied to the SVG shape. If present, it overrides the element's stroke-width attribute.

records.name: text-anchor
records.title: text-anchor CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The text-anchor CSS property aligns a box containing a string of text where the wrapping area is determined from the inline-size property, and the text is then placed relative to the anchor point of the element, which is defined using the x and y (or dx and dy) attributes. If present, the value of the CSS property overrides any value of the element's text-anchor attribute.

records.name: text-rendering
records.title: text-rendering CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The text-rendering CSS property provides information to the rendering engine about what to optimize for when rendering text.

records.name: vector-effect
records.title: vector-effect CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The vector-effect CSS property suppresses specific transformation effects in SVG, thus permitting effects like a road on a map staying the same width no matter how the map is zoomed, or allowing a diagram key to retain its position and size regardless of other transforms. It can only be used with SVG elements that accept the vector-effect attribute. When used, the CSS value overrides any values of the element's vector-effect attribute.

records.name: x
records.title: x CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The x CSS property defines the x-axis coordinate of the top left corner of the SVG <rect> shape, <image> image, <foreignObject> viewport or nested <svg> viewport relative to the nearest <svg> ancestor's user coordinate system. If present, it overrides the element's x attribute.

records.name: y
records.title: y CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The y CSS property defines the y-axis coordinate of the top left corner of the SVG <rect> shape, <image> image, <foreignObject> viewport and nested <svg> viewport relative to the nearest <svg> ancestor's user coordinate system. If present, it overrides the element's y attribute.

records.name: font
records.title: font CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The font CSS shorthand property sets all the different properties of an element's font. Alternatively, it sets an element's font to a system font.

records.name: font-family
records.title: font-family CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The font-family CSS property specifies a prioritized list of one or more font family names and/or generic family names for the selected element.

records.name: font-feature-settings
records.title: font-feature-settings CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The font-feature-settings CSS property controls advanced typographic features in OpenType fonts.

records.name: font-kerning
records.title: font-kerning CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The font-kerning CSS property sets the use of the kerning information stored in a font.

records.name: font-language-override
records.title: font-language-override CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The font-language-override CSS property controls the use of language-specific glyphs in a typeface.

records.name: font-optical-sizing
records.title: font-optical-sizing CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The font-optical-sizing CSS property sets whether text rendering is optimized for viewing at different sizes.

records.name: font-palette
records.title: font-palette CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The font-palette CSS property allows specifying one of the many palettes contained in a color font that a user agent may use for the font. Users can also override the values in a palette or create a new palette by using the @font-palette-values at-rule.

records.name: font-size
records.title: font-size CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The font-size CSS property sets the size of the font. Changing the font size also updates the sizes of the font size-relative <length> units, such as em, ex, and so forth.

records.name: font-size-adjust
records.title: font-size-adjust CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The font-size-adjust CSS property adjusts the size of a font to match a chosen font metric, such as the height of lowercase letters, to a specified proportion of the font-size. This property is intended for adjusting fallback fonts to have similar metrics as the first-choice font.

records.name: font-style
records.title: font-style CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The font-style CSS property sets whether a font should be styled with a normal, italic, or oblique face from its font-family.

records.name: font-synthesis
records.title: font-synthesis CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The font-synthesis CSS shorthand property lets you specify whether or not the browser may synthesize the bold, italic, small-caps, and/or subscript and superscript typefaces when they are missing in the specified font-family.

records.name: font-synthesis-small-caps
records.title: font-synthesis-small-caps CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The font-synthesis-small-caps CSS property lets you specify whether or not the browser may synthesize small-caps typeface when it is missing in a font family. Small-caps glyphs typically use the form of uppercase letters but are reduced to the size of lowercase letters.

records.name: font-synthesis-style
records.title: font-synthesis-style CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The font-synthesis-style CSS property lets you specify whether or not the browser may synthesize the oblique typeface when it is missing in a font family.

records.name: font-synthesis-weight
records.title: font-synthesis-weight CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The font-synthesis-weight CSS property lets you specify whether or not the browser may synthesize the bold typeface when it is missing in a font family.

records.name: font-variant
records.title: font-variant CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The font-variant CSS shorthand property allows you to set all the font variants for a font.

records.name: font-variant-alternates
records.title: font-variant-alternates CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The font-variant-alternates CSS property controls the usage of alternate glyphs. These alternate glyphs may be referenced by alternative names defined in @font-feature-values.

records.name: font-variant-caps
records.title: font-variant-caps CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The font-variant-caps CSS property controls the use of alternate glyphs used for small or petite capitals or for titling.

records.name: font-variant-east-asian
records.title: font-variant-east-asian CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The font-variant-east-asian CSS property controls the use of alternate glyphs for East Asian scripts, like Japanese and Chinese.

records.name: font-variant-emoji
records.title: font-variant-emoji CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The font-variant-emoji CSS property specifies the default presentation style for displaying emojis.

records.name: font-variant-ligatures
records.title: font-variant-ligatures CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The font-variant-ligatures CSS property controls which ligatures and contextual forms are used in the textual content of the elements it applies to. This leads to more harmonized forms in the resulting text.

records.name: font-variant-numeric
records.title: font-variant-numeric CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The font-variant-numeric CSS property controls the usage of alternate glyphs for numbers, fractions, and ordinal markers.

records.name: font-variant-position
records.title: font-variant-position CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The font-variant-position CSS property controls the use of alternate, smaller glyphs that are positioned as superscript or subscript.

records.name: font-variation-settings
records.title: font-variation-settings CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The font-variation-settings CSS property provides low-level control over variable font characteristics by letting you specify the four letter axis names of the characteristics you want to vary along with their values.

records.name: font-weight
records.title: font-weight CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The font-weight CSS property sets the weight (or boldness) of the font. The weights available depend on the font-family that is currently set.

records.name: hanging-punctuation
records.title: hanging-punctuation CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The hanging-punctuation CSS property specifies whether a punctuation mark should hang at the start or end of a line of text. Hanging punctuation may be placed outside the line box.

records.name: hyphenate-character
records.title: hyphenate-character CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The hyphenate-character CSS property sets the character (or string) used at the end of a line before a hyphenation break.

records.name: hyphenate-limit-chars
records.title: hyphenate-limit-chars CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The hyphenate-limit-chars CSS property specifies the minimum word length to allow hyphenation of words as well as the minimum number of characters before and after the hyphen.

records.name: hyphens
records.title: hyphens CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The hyphens CSS property specifies how words should be hyphenated when text wraps across multiple lines.

records.name: letter-spacing
records.title: letter-spacing CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The letter-spacing CSS property sets the spacing between text characters. This value is added to the natural spacing between characters while rendering the text. Positive values of letter-spacing spread characters further apart, while negative values of letter-spacing bring characters closer together.

records.name: line-break
records.title: line-break CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The line-break CSS property sets how to break lines of Chinese, Japanese, or Korean (CJK) text when working with punctuation and symbols.

records.name: overflow-wrap
records.title: overflow-wrap CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The overflow-wrap CSS property applies to text, setting whether the browser should insert line breaks within an otherwise unbreakable string to prevent text from overflowing its line box.

records.name: tab-size
records.title: tab-size CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The tab-size CSS property is used to customize the width of tab characters (U+0009).

records.name: text-align
records.title: text-align CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The text-align CSS property sets the horizontal alignment of the inline-level content inside a block element or table-cell box. This means it works like vertical-align but in the horizontal direction.

records.name: text-align-last
records.title: text-align-last CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The text-align-last CSS property sets how the last line of a block or a line, right before a forced line break, is aligned.

records.name: text-autospace
records.title: text-autospace CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The text-autospace CSS property allows you to specify the space applied between Chinese/Japanese/Korean (CJK) and non-CJK characters.

records.name: text-fit
records.title: text-fit CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The text-fit CSS property can be used to scale the rendered font size of text nodes (and other inline content) so that they fit exactly within the inline dimension of their containing boxes, optionally limited by a maximum or minimum scaling factor.

records.name: text-indent
records.title: text-indent CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The text-indent CSS property sets the length of empty space (indentation) that is put before lines of text in a block.

records.name: text-justify
records.title: text-justify CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The text-justify CSS property sets what type of justification should be applied to text when text-align: justify; is set on an element.

records.name: text-transform
records.title: text-transform CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The text-transform CSS property specifies how to capitalize an element's text. It can be used to make text appear in all-uppercase or all-lowercase, or with each word capitalized. It also can help improve legibility for ruby.

records.name: text-wrap
records.title: text-wrap CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The text-wrap CSS shorthand property controls how text inside an element is wrapped. The different values provide:

records.name: text-wrap-mode
records.title: text-wrap-mode CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The text-wrap-mode CSS property controls whether the text inside an element is wrapped.

records.name: text-wrap-style
records.title: text-wrap-style CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The text-wrap-style CSS property controls how text inside an element is wrapped, providing alternate ways of determining where to create line breaks in order to fit the content within a block element.

records.name: white-space
records.title: white-space CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The white-space CSS shorthand property sets how white space inside an element is handled.

records.name: white-space-collapse
records.title: white-space-collapse CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The white-space-collapse CSS property controls how white space inside an element is collapsed.

records.name: word-break
records.title: word-break CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The word-break CSS property sets whether line breaks appear wherever the text would otherwise overflow its content box.

records.name: word-spacing
records.title: word-spacing CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The word-spacing CSS property sets the spacing between words and between tags.

records.name: word-wrap
records.title: Page not found | MDN
records.description: Legacy alias of overflow-wrap, which lets browsers break an otherwise unbreakable string to prevent inline overflow.

records.name: image-orientation
records.title: image-orientation CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The image-orientation CSS property specifies a layout-independent correction to the orientation of an image.

records.name: image-rendering
records.title: image-rendering CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The image-rendering CSS property sets an image scaling algorithm. The property applies to an element itself, to any images set in its other properties, and to its descendants.

records.name: object-fit
records.title: object-fit CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The object-fit CSS property sets how the content of a replaced element, such as an or

records.name: object-position
records.title: object-position CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The object-position CSS property specifies the alignment of the selected replaced element's contents within the element's box. Areas of the box which aren't covered by the replaced element's object will show the element's background.

records.name: math-depth
records.title: math-depth CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The math-depth property describes a notion of depth for each element of a mathematical formula, with respect to the top-level container of that formula. This is used to scale the computed value of the font-size of elements when font-size: math is applied.

records.name: math-style
records.title: math-style CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The math-style property indicates whether MathML equations should render with normal or compact height.

records.name: offset
records.title: offset CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The offset CSS shorthand property sets all the properties required for animating an element along a defined path. The offset properties together help to define an offset transform, a transform that aligns a point in an element (offset-anchor) to an offset position (offset-position) on a path (offset-path) at various points along the path (offset-distance) and optionally rotates the element (offset-rotate) to follow the direction of the path.

records.name: offset-anchor
records.title: offset-anchor CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The offset-anchor CSS property specifies the point inside the box of an element traveling along an offset-path that is actually moving along the path.

records.name: offset-distance
records.title: offset-distance CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The offset-distance CSS property specifies a position along an offset-path for an element to be placed.

records.name: offset-path
records.title: offset-path CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The offset-path CSS property specifies a path for an element to follow and determines the element's positioning within the path's parent container or the SVG coordinate system. The path is a line, a curve, or a geometrical shape along which the element gets positioned or moves.

records.name: offset-position
records.title: offset-position CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The offset-position CSS property defines the initial position of an element along a path. This property is typically used in combination with the offset-path property to create a motion effect. The value of offset-position determines where the element gets placed initially for moving along an offset path if an offset-path function such as path() does not specify its own starting position.

records.name: offset-rotate
records.title: offset-rotate CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The offset-rotate CSS property defines the orientation/direction of the element as it is positioned along the offset-path.

records.name: page
records.title: page CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The page CSS property is used to specify the named page, a specific type of page defined by the @page at-rule.

records.name: ruby-align
records.title: ruby-align CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The ruby-align CSS property defines the distribution of the different ruby elements over the base.

records.name: ruby-overhang
records.title: ruby-overhang CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The ruby-overhang CSS property specifies whether or not a <ruby> annotation overhangs any surrounding text.

records.name: ruby-position
records.title: ruby-position CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The ruby-position CSS property defines the position of a ruby element relative to its base element. It can be positioned over the element (over), under it (under), or to the right (inter-character).

records.name: shape-image-threshold
records.title: shape-image-threshold CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The shape-image-threshold CSS property sets the alpha channel threshold used to extract the shape using an image as the value for shape-outside.

records.name: shape-margin
records.title: shape-margin CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The shape-margin CSS property sets a margin for a CSS shape created using shape-outside.

records.name: shape-outside
records.title: shape-outside CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The shape-outside CSS property defines a shape—which may be non-rectangular—around which adjacent inline content should wrap. By default, inline content wraps around its margin box; shape-outside provides a way to customize this wrapping, making it possible to wrap text around complex objects rather than rectangular boxes.

records.name: text-decoration
records.title: text-decoration CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The text-decoration CSS shorthand property sets the appearance of decorative lines on text. It is a shorthand for text-decoration-line, text-decoration-color, text-decoration-style, and the newer text-decoration-thickness property.

records.name: text-decoration-color
records.title: text-decoration-color CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The text-decoration-color CSS property sets the color of decorations added to text by text-decoration-line.

records.name: text-decoration-inset
records.title: text-decoration-inset CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The text-decoration-inset CSS property enables adjusting the start and end points of an element's text decoration so it can be shortened, lengthened, or have its position shifted with respect to the rendered text.

records.name: text-decoration-line
records.title: text-decoration-line CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The text-decoration-line CSS property sets the kind of decoration that is used on text in an element, such as an underline or overline.

records.name: text-decoration-skip-ink
records.title: text-decoration-skip-ink CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The text-decoration-skip-ink CSS property specifies how overlines and underlines are drawn when they pass over glyph ascenders and descenders.

records.name: text-decoration-style
records.title: text-decoration-style CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The text-decoration-style CSS property sets the style of the lines specified by text-decoration-line. The style applies to all lines that are set with text-decoration-line.

records.name: text-decoration-thickness
records.title: text-decoration-thickness CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The text-decoration-thickness CSS property sets the stroke thickness of the decoration line that is used on text in an element, such as a line-through, underline, or overline.

records.name: text-emphasis
records.title: text-emphasis CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The text-emphasis CSS shorthand property applies emphasis marks to text (except spaces and control characters).

records.name: text-emphasis-color
records.title: text-emphasis-color CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The text-emphasis-color CSS property sets the color of emphasis marks. This value can also be set using the text-emphasis shorthand.

records.name: text-emphasis-position
records.title: text-emphasis-position CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The text-emphasis-position CSS property sets where emphasis marks are drawn. Similar to the text rendered by the <ruby> HTML element, if there isn't enough room for emphasis marks, the line height is increased.

records.name: text-emphasis-style
records.title: text-emphasis-style CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The text-emphasis-style CSS property sets the appearance of emphasis marks. It can also be set, and reset, using the text-emphasis shorthand.

records.name: text-shadow
records.title: text-shadow CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The text-shadow CSS property adds shadows to text. It accepts a comma-separated list of shadows to be applied to the text and any of its text-decoration. Each shadow is described by some combination of X and Y offsets from the element, blur radius, and color.

records.name: text-underline-offset
records.title: text-underline-offset CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The text-underline-offset CSS property sets the offset distance of an underline text decoration line (applied using text-decoration) from its original position.

records.name: text-underline-position
records.title: text-underline-position CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The text-underline-position CSS property specifies the position of the underline which is set using the text-decoration property's underline value.

records.name: touch-action
records.title: touch-action CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The touch-action CSS property sets how an element's region can be manipulated by a touchscreen user (for example, by zooming features built into the browser).

records.name: transition
records.title: transition CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The transition CSS shorthand property for transition-property, transition-duration, transition-timing-function, transition-delay, and transition-behavior.

records.name: transition-behavior
records.title: transition-behavior CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The transition-behavior CSS property specifies whether transitions will be started for properties whose animation behavior is discrete.

records.name: transition-delay
