records.title: transition-delay CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The transition-delay CSS property specifies the duration to wait before starting a property's transition effect when its value changes.

records.name: transition-duration
records.title: transition-duration CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The transition-duration CSS property sets the length of time a transition animation should take to complete. By default, the value is 0s, meaning that no animation will occur.

records.name: transition-property
records.title: transition-property CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The transition-property CSS property sets the CSS properties to which a transition effect should be applied.

records.name: transition-timing-function
records.title: transition-timing-function CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The transition-timing-function CSS property sets how intermediate values are calculated for CSS properties being affected by a transition effect.

records.name: view-transition-class
records.title: view-transition-class CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The view-transition-class CSS property provides the selected elements with one or more identifying classes (<custom-ident>s), providing an additional method of styling the view transitions for those elements.

records.name: view-transition-name
records.title: view-transition-name CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The view-transition-name CSS property specifies the view transition snapshot that selected elements will participate in. This enables you to animate those elements separately from the rest of the page, which uses the default cross-fade animation during a view transition. You can then define custom animation styles for these elements.

records.name: view-transition-scope
records.title: view-transition-scope CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The view-transition-scope CSS property enables the discoverability of elements with view-transition-name values set on them (and therefore the creation of view transition snapshots) to be isolated to a specific element subtree.

records.name: will-change
records.title: will-change CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The will-change CSS property enables optimizing animations by providing a rendering hint to a browser about how an element is expected to change.

records.name: animation-range
records.title: animation-range CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The animation-range CSS shorthand property is used to set the start and end of an animation's attachment range along its timeline, i.e., where along the timeline an animation will start and end.

records.name: animation-range-end
records.title: animation-range-end CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The animation-range-end CSS property sets the point on the timeline where an animation should end.

records.name: animation-range-start
records.title: animation-range-start CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The animation-range-start CSS property sets the point on the timeline where an animation should start.

records.name: scroll-timeline
records.title: scroll-timeline CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The scroll-timeline CSS shorthand property is used to define a named scroll progress timeline, which is progressed through by scrolling a scrollable element (scroller) between top and bottom (or left and right).

records.name: scroll-timeline-axis
records.title: scroll-timeline-axis CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The scroll-timeline-axis CSS property is used to specify the scrollbar direction that will be used to provide the timeline for a scroll driven animation, which is progressed through by scrolling a scrollable element (scroller).

records.name: scroll-timeline-name
records.title: scroll-timeline-name CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The scroll-timeline-name CSS property is used to define the name of a named scroll progress timeline.

records.name: timeline-scope
records.title: timeline-scope CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The timeline-scope CSS property modifies the scope of a named animation timeline.

records.name: view-timeline
records.title: view-timeline CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The view-timeline CSS shorthand property defines a named view progress timeline's name, direction, and inset values.

records.name: view-timeline-axis
records.title: view-timeline-axis CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The view-timeline-axis CSS property specifies the scroll direction to be used for a named view progress timeline.

records.name: view-timeline-inset
records.title: view-timeline-inset CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The view-timeline-inset CSS property is used to specify one or two values representing an adjustment to the position of the scrollport (see Scroll container for more details) in which the subject element of a named view progress timeline animation is deemed to be visible. Put another way, this allows you to specify start and/or end inset (or outset) values that offset the position of the timeline.

records.name: view-timeline-name
records.title: view-timeline-name CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The view-timeline-name CSS property specifies the names of one or more named view progress timelines associated with the element.

records.name: animation-timeline
records.title: animation-timeline CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The animation-timeline CSS property specifies the timeline used to control the progress of a CSS animation.

records.name: field-sizing
records.title: field-sizing CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The field-sizing CSS property enables you to control the sizing behavior of elements that are given a default preferred size, such as form control elements. This property enables you to override the default sizing behavior, allowing form controls to adjust in size to fit their contents.

records.name: font-synthesis-position
records.title: font-synthesis-position CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The font-synthesis-position CSS property lets you specify whether or not a browser may synthesize the subscript and superscript "position" typefaces when they are missing in a font family, while using font-variant-position to set the positions.

records.name: font-width
records.title: font-width CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The font-width CSS property selects a normal, condensed, or expanded face from a font.

records.name: image-resolution
records.title: image-resolution CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The image-resolution CSS property specifies the intrinsic resolution of all raster images used in or on the element. It affects content images such as replaced elements and generated content, and decorative images such as background-image images.

records.name: object-view-box
records.title: object-view-box CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The object-view-box CSS property defines a rectangle as a viewable area (viewbox) within a replaced element, enabling the content of the replaced element to be zoomed or panned. It works similarly to the SVG viewBox attribute.

records.name: initial-letter-align
records.title: Page not found | MDN
records.description: Working Draft property that chooses the baseline alignment points used to size and position an initial letter, with script-sensitive values such as alphabetic, ideographic, hanging, and leading.
records.supportLabel: W3C Editor’s Draft; no browser support reported by MDN

records.name: interpolate-size
records.title: interpolate-size CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The interpolate-size CSS property allows you to enable animations and transitions between a <length-percentage> value and an intrinsic size, fit-content, or max-content.

records.name: link-parameters
records.title: link-parameters CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The link-parameters CSS property sets values of external resources, such as SVGs, whose attributes have been set with the env() CSS function

records.name: line-height-step
records.title: line-height-step CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The line-height-step CSS property sets the step unit for line box heights. When the property is set, line box heights are rounded up to the closest multiple of the unit.

records.name: margin-trim
records.title: margin-trim CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The margin-trim property allows the container to trim the margins of its children where they adjoin the container's edges.

records.name: math-shift
records.title: math-shift CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The math-shift property indicates whether superscripts inside MathML formulas should be raised by a normal or compact shift.

records.name: ruby-merge
records.title: Page not found | MDN
records.description: Working Draft property that controls how ruby annotation boxes share space across their associated base text using separate, merge, or auto behavior.

records.name: speak-as
records.title: speak-as CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The speak-as CSS property is used to define how HTML content is spoken. The one to three enumerated key terms determine the manner by which elements and text get rendered by aural technologies, such as screen readers and digital assistants.

records.name: stroke-color
records.title: Page not found | MDN
records.description: CSS Fill and Stroke Level 3 property that supplies color paint for CSS/SVG strokes; the published specification is a First Public Working Draft and its current editor draft is still evolving.

records.name: text-decoration-skip
records.title: text-decoration-skip CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The text-decoration-skip CSS property sets what parts of an element's content any text decoration affecting the element must skip over. It controls all text decoration lines drawn by the element and also any text decoration lines drawn by its ancestors.

records.name: text-size-adjust
records.title: text-size-adjust CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The text-size-adjust CSS property controls the text inflation algorithm used on some smartphones and tablets. Other browsers will ignore this property.

records.name: text-spacing-trim
records.title: text-spacing-trim CSS property - CSS | MDN
records.description: The text-spacing-trim CSS property controls the internal spacing set on Chinese/Japanese/Korean (CJK) punctuation characters between adjacent characters (kerning) and at the start or end of text lines.
